hero.title: Citizen voice & accountability
hero.subtitle: Strengthening participation, especially for women and youth, and building bridges to decision‑makers.

challenge.heading: The Challenge
challenge.text: Communities, especially women and youth, often lack the information, space and channels to participate in decisions that affect them or to hold service providers and authorities to account. EKSS’s Advocacy & Civic Engagement programme strengthens citizen voice, participation and accountability.

items.title: Civic awareness
items.description: Building understanding of rights, entitlements and how to engage in public processes.

items.title: Community platforms
items.description: Strengthening inclusive community structures and forums for dialogue and accountability.

items.title: Constructive engagement
items.description: Facilitating respectful, evidence‑based engagement with decision‑makers and service providers.

items.title: Inclusion of voice
items.description: Creating deliberate space for women, youth and marginalised groups to be heard and to lead.

currentWork.heading: What We Are Doing Now
items: Community dialogue series in Juba and surrounding areas, bringing together residents, local leaders and service providers.
"Councillors for Citizens" initiative, supporting elected representatives to be more responsive and accountable.
Civic awareness sessions on rights, governance and participation, with a focus on women and youth.
Facilitating constructive engagement between communities and local authorities on service delivery issues.

rows.outcome: Community members engaged in civic education and dialogue

items.title: Community Dialogue Series
items.description: Regular, facilitated dialogues that give community members a safe space to raise concerns and propose solutions directly to duty‑bearers.

items.title: Councillors for Citizens
items.description: Supporting elected local representatives to hold regular community meetings, report back and take action on citizen priorities.

partners.heading: Partners & Donors
partners.text: Community structures, civil‑society networks, local authorities and service providers, and governance‑ and civic‑space donors.

resources.heading: Resources
resources.text: Advocacy brief, dialogue guides and civic education materials.

cta.heading: Strengthen Civic Voice
cta.text: Help communities participate in decisions that shape their lives.
